title: Minuta 2026-02-05
summary: The minutes of the 5 February meeting record a unanimous hold at 7.00%, with Heath voting with the majority but dissenting on the communique's wording, and they reveal a Board more dovish than the communique: the majority treats the January IEPS and tariff increases as a one-off relative-price adjustment with no second-round effects, backed by ample slack, the weakest IMSS hiring since 2020 and a strong peso. Three members actively discuss resuming cuts -- one says the pause 'pudiera incluso ser más corta de lo previsto', another that the Board should communicate 'existe espacio para continuar con los recortes', a third points to the next meeting and the Programa Monetario's 'continuar con los ajustes' -- while a fourth wants to keep the current stance and watch the data. Heath is the lone hawk, arguing 2025 brought no disinflation progress, that a single-meeting pause is not enough and that patience through at least H1 2026 should be signalled; his dissent objects that dropping 'el momento' signals a premature cut. Versus the December minutes, where the Board was still cutting but stressing gradualism and caution, the action has moved to a pause, yet the majority's bias toward resuming cuts soon is, if anything, more explicit.

key_quotes.quote: la pausa actual pudiera incluso ser más corta de lo previsto.
key_quotes.context: One member: contained, focalized fiscal shock means the pause could be shorter than expected

key_quotes.quote: Consideró adecuado comunicar que existe espacio para continuar con los recortes, procurando la convergencia eficiente a la meta y un ajuste ordenado de la economía.
key_quotes.context: Another member wants the Board to signal room to keep cutting (slack, weak dollar, less restrictive Fed)

key_quotes.quote: la entrada en vigor de las modificaciones tributarias y arancelarias constituye principalmente un ajuste de precios relativos.
key_quotes.context: The majority looks through the IEPS and tariff shock; no second-round effects expected

key_quotes.quote: Mencionó que el pausar solamente en esta ocasión no es suficiente, sino que se debe hacer una pausa prolongada hasta obtener evidencia de avances adicionales en la convergencia.
key_quotes.context: Heath, the hawkish counterweight: wants a prolonged pause and patience through H1 2026
